release_rules: One physical location, multiple ministries and Mass services if applicable; never count each affiliation as a second church.
For travel searches, official timetable > third-party directory > stale PDFs. Do not silently use seasonal historical Mass times.
Original local language evidence must be accessible; translate interface summaries into French and English without altering church names.
Keep 1962 Roman, Dominican Old Rite, Ordinariate Divine Worship, Eastern Catholic, and ordinary-form Latin as distinct liturgies.
No made-up coordinates; map only verified navigable destinations, otherwise city-only evidence link with an explicit location uncertainty.
The ability to filter for Mass on a specific future date does not mean an unverified Sunday time is a guaranteed open Mass.
Special closures, temporary moves, summer schedules and feast-day exceptions outrank generic week patterns.
